name: m4-closed-scopes-typer

variantDescriptions.closed: retronym/scala#241 (closed scopes, no per-type flag) plus scala/scala#11381 (`claude/closed-scope-bench`)
variantDescriptions.closed-chunked: `closed` plus the chunked weak table of retronym/scala#239 (`claude/closed-scope-bench-chunked`), `-Dscala.uniques.layout=chunked-weak`
variantDescriptions.closed-chunked-strong: `closed` plus the chunked table of retronym/scala#239 holding its types strongly (`-Dscala.uniques.layout=chunked`): no `WeakReference` per entry, every interned type kept to the end of the run, the closed scopes keeping the throwaway ones out

description: Does leaving types made in closed scopes out of the uniques table pay in the typer? retronym/scala#241 against its base (retronym/scala#212), both with scala/scala#11381 so that a run stopped after the typer does not invalidate infos and base type sequences at each phase switch. Separate forks, scala corpus to `-Ystop-after:typer`, one compile at a time, 8 GB G1, patched JDK 26, M4. Read GC pause sums from `gc.log` as well as the score.
